oled_fit_evidence: Provisional generic envelope; actual PCB, glass, pins and controller not identified. Winstar WEA012864D-03 gives 27.3 mm square, Joy-IT SBC-OLED01 gives 27 mm square; neither identifies the user board. No board hole pitch assumed.
led_fit_evidence: 60 LEDs/m confirmed; 10 mm strip width and 5050 package provisional. Five-pixel cut length, coating and pads require measurement.
power_note: 12 V jack hole user-drilled after checking jack body and wire clearance. Reserve is not a buck mount; 12 V must convert to 5 V before electronics.
esp_wire_envelope_evidence: Provisional 22-pin 2.54 mm header-row length; route wires inside 55.8 mm length and 25 mm height. Exact board and wire fit require verification.
